== Notes ==
* Consider using with [[Steady Stance]] or [[Balanced Stance]] to bypass the knock down penalty.
* This skill will only knock you down if it hits.
* Contrary to [[Grapple]], [[Stonefist Insignia]] does not prolong the time you are knocked down.
* If this attack hits multiple targets by using a [[scythe]], the conditions are applied separately. You are also knocked down separately for each hit, which matters if preventing knock downs.

== Trivia ==
* The figure in this [[skill icon]] is also used in the skill icon for [[Backfire]].
